name: mk-company-formation
description: North Macedonia mainland entity choice and tax handover for calendar year 2026. Use for choosing between an ordinary limited liability company, single member company, sole trader, partnership, joint stock company or local branch. Covers the ordinary LLC partner range and capital, registration evidence, ownership and manager details, activity permissions, and the tax and insurance obligations that must be handed over after incorporation. Distinguishes company profit tax from the proprietor's personal income tax and separates registered employees from uninsured directors and self-employed people. Routes computations to the current country tax skills. Does not quote unconfirmed fees, promise an incorporation turnaround or apply ordinary LLC capital to a specialist simplified or regulated form. Checked against the law (tier 2); awaiting professional review.
